EE.title: Creamy Cheesy Buldak Noodles 🌶️🧀🥟 Ingredients 2 slices cheddar cheese 1 slice baby Swiss cheese 2 tbsp ketchup 2 tbsp Kewpie mayo 1 tbsp chili oil, plus more for topping 1 packet Buldak sauce and seasoning powder 2–3 tbsp chopped green onions, plus more for garnish ½ cup heavy cream 1 packet Buldak noodles, boiled until half cooked ½–1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese Cooked dumplings, for topping Cooked sausage, sliced, for topping 1 fried egg, for topping Instructions In a pan over low heat, add the cheddar cheese, baby Swiss cheese, ketchup, Kewpie mayo, chili oil, Buldak sauce, seasoning powder, and chopped green onions. Stir until the cheese melts and everything is well combined. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Add the half-cooked Buldak noodles and toss until completely coated in the sauce. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the noodles and let it melt into the creamy sauce. Top with cooked dumplings, sliced sausage, and a fried egg. Finish with an extra drizzle of chili oil and chopped green onions. Serve hot and enjoy! #ramen #buldak #spicynoodles #Foodie #cook

GLOBAL.title: Creamy Cheesy Buldak Noodles 🌶️🧀🥟 Ingredients 2 slices cheddar cheese 1 slice baby Swiss cheese 2 tbsp ketchup 2 tbsp Kewpie mayo 1 tbsp chili oil, plus more for topping 1 packet Buldak sauce and seasoning powder 2–3 tbsp chopped green onions, plus more for garnish ½ cup heavy cream 1 packet Buldak noodles, boiled until half cooked ½–1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese Cooked dumplings, for topping Cooked sausage, sliced, for topping 1 fried egg, for topping Instructions In a pan over low heat, add the cheddar cheese, baby Swiss cheese, ketchup, Kewpie mayo, chili oil, Buldak sauce, seasoning powder, and chopped green onions. Stir until the cheese melts and everything is well combined. Pour in the heavy cream and mix until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Add the half-cooked Buldak noodles and toss until completely coated in the sauce. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over the noodles and let it melt into the creamy sauce. Top with cooked dumplings, sliced sausage, and a fried egg. Finish with an extra drizzle of chili oil and chopped green onions. Serve hot and enjoy! #ramen #buldak #spicynoodles #Foodie #cook
